phase_1.title: Phase 1 · T-90M Firing Solenoid & Primer Ignition
phase_1.description: Closing the crew firing circuit energizes the breech firing pin, igniting the primary propellant charge inside the sealed 125mm 2A46M-5 Smoothbore (3BM60 Svinets-2) chamber.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 650 MPa Chamber Deflagration
phase_2.description: Rapid propellant burn drives chamber pressure to 650 MPa against the heavy locked breechblock while accelerating the heavy projectile.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 6000 mm Ordnance Acceleration
phase_3.description: Expanding gases accelerate the 125mm 2A46M-5 Smoothbore (3BM60 Svinets-2) round along the 6000 mm barrel up to 1750 m/s (11,800,000 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Bore Clearance & Muzzle Blast
phase_4.description: The projectile clears the muzzle crown cleanly for engagements out to 4000 m while bore gases evacuate safely away from the crew.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Hydropneumatic Recoil Absorption
phase_5.description: Recoil cylinders absorb 28500 N-s of impulse smoothly across the cradle while transferring residual load into the chassis.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Breech Opening & Stub Extraction
phase_6.description: During battery runout, hull carousel autoloader hoists and rams projectile and propellant charge into the vertical wedge breech, ejecting the spent base stub cleanly into the deflector bin.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Munition Ramming & Battery Lock
phase_7.description: The next 125mm 2A46M-5 Smoothbore (3BM60 Svinets-2) round seats into the chamber and locks the breechblock back into firing readiness.

zh.headline: 俄罗斯 T-90M “突破-3” 1:1 主战坦克：2020 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: T-90M “突破-3”是俄式低矮三乘员坦克谱系的集大成者：全新焊接炮塔覆挂“化石”（Relikt）双层爆炸反应装甲，底置转盘自动装弹机加装防崩落装甲罩，并将额外弹药移至炮塔外置泄压尾舱。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：T-90M 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 2020 年问世的 俄罗斯 T-90M “突破-3” 1:1 主战坦克 由俄罗斯乌拉尔机车车辆厂（Uralvagonzavod）主导研制，定位为经典的现代主战坦克（1:1 真实尺度）。T-90M 于 2020 年正式列装，将炮塔主装甲外部尾舱与车内防破片凯夫拉内衬引入传统 T-72/T-90 底盘，显著提升了整车弹药隔爆生存性。
T-90M “突破-3”是俄式低矮三乘员坦克谱系的集大成者：全新焊接炮塔覆挂“化石”（Relikt）双层爆炸反应装甲，底置转盘自动装弹机加装防崩落装甲罩，并将额外弹药移至炮塔外置泄压尾舱。 整件装备总长 9,530 mm（含炮管向前 · 车体 6,860 mm）、空重 48000 kg，成为同期重装坦克领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。2020 年，俄罗斯乌拉尔机车车辆厂（Uralvagonzavod）推出了划时代的俄罗斯 T-90M “突破-3” 1:1 主战坦克。T-90M 于 2020 年正式列装，将炮塔主装甲外部尾舱与车内防破片凯夫拉内衬引入传统 T-72/T-90 底盘，显著提升了整车弹药隔爆生存性。 它的核心设计聚焦于2A46M-5 125mm 滑膛炮适配加长型 3BM60 钨合金脱壳穿甲弹，奠定了其在重装坦克发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主战坦克复合装甲炮塔壳体

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 俄罗斯 T-90M “突破-3” 1:1 主战坦克 的机械灵魂在于其「22 发装甲防护底置转盘自动装弹机 · 立楔半自动炮闩」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，底置转盘自动装弹机自动提升定装/分装炮弹与药筒推入滑膛炮闩闭锁，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用俄军墨绿特种涂装均质轧制与爆反装甲钢精加工而成。装甲包覆式 22 发底置转盘自动装弹机 + 外置炮塔尾舱备弹箱，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。俄罗斯 T-90M “突破-3” 1:1 主战坦克 采用22 发装甲防护底置转盘自动装弹机 · 立楔半自动炮闩。在每个击发周期中，底置转盘自动装弹机自动提升定装/分装炮弹与药筒推入滑膛炮闩闭锁。借助俄军墨绿特种涂装均质轧制与爆反装甲钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了装甲包覆式 22 发底置转盘自动装弹机 + 外置炮塔尾舱备弹箱。
acts.focusPartLabel: 重型立楔/螺式主炮炮闩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 125mm 2A46M-5 Smoothbore (3BM60 Svinets-2) 弹药规格与 6,000 mm（125mm L/48 镀铬滑膛炮 · 热护套 + 抽烟装置），最高工作膛压约 650 MPa，可赋予弹头 1750 m/s 的出膛初速与 11,800,000 J 动能，有效作用距离达 4000 米。
内膛技术特点方面，125mm L/48 高压电渣重熔镀铬滑膛身管，发射尾翼稳定脱壳穿甲弹与炮射导弹。同时，全向“化石”Relikt 模块化双飞板反应装甲 + 车体格栅护网，令其在 8 发/分（转盘自动装填） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 6000 毫米身管与 125mm 2A46M-5 Smoothbore (3BM60 Svinets-2) 口径，俄罗斯 T-90M “突破-3” 1:1 主战坦克 实现了每秒 1750 米的初速与 4000 米有效射程。125mm L/48 高压电渣重熔镀铬滑膛身管，发射尾翼稳定脱壳穿甲弹与炮射导弹，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 22 发容量的底置转盘自动装弹机弹仓与 1620 mm 膛轴设计，俄罗斯 T-90M “突破-3” 1:1 主战坦克 将单发后坐冲量控制在 28500 N·s 水平。V-92S2F 1,130 马力涡轮增压柴油机与“卡利纳”猎歼数字火控。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-94）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 22 发容量的底置转盘自动装弹机弹仓与出色的整体工效，V-92S2F 1,130 马力涡轮增压柴油机与“卡利纳”猎歼数字火控。欢迎在 BAY-94 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 俄罗斯 T-90M “突破-3” 1:1 主战坦克 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the T-90M
paragraphs: Introduced in 2020 by Uralvagonzavod in Russia, the T-90M Proryv-3 Main Battle Tank emerged as a defining Modern Main Battle Tank (1:1 Scale). Fielded in 2020, the T-90M introduced an external bustle ammunition box, spall liners, and Kalina hunter-killer optics onto the proven compact T-72/T-90 chassis.

The T-90M Proryv-3 represents the pinnacle of compact three-crew Russian MBT design, pairing a welded turret clad in Relikt dual-plate ERA with an armored floor carousel autoloader and isolated external bustle stowage. Measuring 9,530 mm (gun forward · 6,860 mm hull) at an unloaded weight of 48000 kg, it reshaped expectations across the 1:1 Main Battle Tank class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 2020, Uralvagonzavod of Russia introduced the T-90M Proryv-3 Main Battle Tank. Fielded in 2020, the T-90M introduced an external bustle ammunition box, spall liners, and Kalina hunter-killer optics onto the proven compact T-72/T-90 chassis. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — 2A46M-5 125mm smoothbore supports elongated 3BM60 tungsten APFSDS rods — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the T-90M Proryv-3 Main Battle Tank sits its 22-Round Armored Hull-Floor Carousel Autoloader · Vertical Sliding-Wedge Breech. Throughout every firing cycle, hull carousel autoloader hoists and rams projectile and propellant charge into the vertical wedge breech, containing 650 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in Russian dark-green rolled homogeneous and ERA armor steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Armored 22-round hull carousel paired with isolated external turret bustle rack, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The T-90M Proryv-3 Main Battle Tank relies on 22-Round Armored Hull-Floor Carousel Autoloader · Vertical Sliding-Wedge Breech. During each cycle, hull carousel autoloader hoists and rams projectile and propellant charge into the vertical wedge breech. Machined from Russian dark-green rolled homogeneous and ERA armor steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Armored 22-round hull carousel paired with isolated external turret bustle rack.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 125mm 2A46M-5 Smoothbore (3BM60 Svinets-2) with 6,000 mm (125mm L/48 Chrome-Lined Smoothbore · Thermal Sleeve), the T-90M Proryv-3 Main Battle Tank develops 1750 m/s muzzle velocity and 11,800,000 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 4000 meters.

Internally, 125mm L/48 chrome-lined smoothbore firing fin-stabilized APFSDS darts and gun-launched ATGMs. Combined with its 8 RPM (carousel autoloader) tempo, Relikt dual-flyer modular ERA skirt arrays with rear slat armor protection, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 125mm 2A46M-5 Smoothbore (3BM60 Svinets-2) through its 6000 millimeter bore, the T-90M Proryv-3 Main Battle Tank achieves 1750 meters per second and 4000 meters of effective reach. 125mm L/48 chrome-lined smoothbore firing fin-stabilized APFSDS darts and gun-launched ATGMs.
